F24D.en:
DOMESTIC- OR SPACE-HEATING SYSTEMS, e.g. CENTRAL HEATING SYSTEMS; DOMESTIC HOT-WATER SUPPLY SYSTEMS; ELEMENTS OR COMPONENTS THEREFOR(using steam or condensate extracted or exhausted from steam engine plants for heating purposes F01K17/02);

Note(s)

  • In this subclass, the following expression is used with the meaning indicated:
    • "central heating system" means a system in which heat is generated or stored at central sources and is distributed by means of a transfer fluid to the spaces or areas to be heated.

F24.ja:

    注

このクラスにおいては，下記の用語は以下に示す意味で用いる：
―“ストーブ”は開放式炉，例．暖炉，を持つような装置を包含する；
―“レンジ”は種々の調理操作または調理と加熱操作をする要素をもった調理装置を意味する。
F24.en:
HEATING; RANGES; VENTILATING;

Note(s)

  • In this class, the following terms are used with the meanings indicated:
    • "stove" includes apparatus which may have an open fire, e.g. fireplace;
    • "range" means an apparatus for cooking having elements that perform different cooking operations or cooking and heating operations.
